title: Zavora's Copper: Core
description: Copper Addictions and other no-needed things. For PLS2
body:
# **Zavora's Copper: Core**
## What That's?
### Exclusive mod for PLS2 Modpack
## Zavora's Copper: _Series_
- Zavora's Copper: Core **(this mod)**
- Zavora's Copper: Armor (will be soon)
- Zavora's Copper: Structures (will be soon)
- ~~Copper CORE~~ (deleted)
## What added?
- Hazmat suit
- Copper Armor
- Rail craft with copper
- Smallest redstone emitter
- Rubber
- Radioactive clusters
- Caramel blocks (each block has its own booster)
- Caramel fluid
- Caramelberries
- Caramel bricket
## Dependencies
- Create
- Vic's Point Blank
## **Not all addings have crafts at this moment**.
